text.description_html:
RK International CK-313, Black Porcelain Knob with Traditional Rose

In the Black Porcelain Cabinet Knob with Metal Center, RK Intentional has blended two mediums to make something truly stunning. The porcelain is sleek and shiny while the brass (available in 4 finishes) adds industrial chicness. Choose from polished chrome, polished brass, satin nickel, or oil rubbed bronze finishes (click picture to the right to see them all). The metal center and the rose finishes will match. This cabinet knob is great for the kitchen, the bathroom vanity, or even dresser drawers.

Also Available Matching: 1" Black Porcelain Cabinet Knob with Metal Center and White Porcelain Cabinet Knob with Metal Center

Specifications and Features of the RK International CK 313 Black Porcelain Knob with Metal Tip:

  • Material: porcelain with some brass
  • Porcelain Color: Black
  • Diameter: 1-1/4"
  • Projection: 1-3/8"
  • Screw: 1" long #8 - 32 machine screw.
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Sold Individually
